available.quote: The board shall certify as qualified for certification by endorsement any applicant who: Meets the requirements for certification as set forth in this section; has passed a national, regional, state, or United States territorial licensing examination that is substantially equivalent to the examination required by this part

requirements.value: Applicant must meet one of: (a) passed substantially equivalent exam and met FL requirements; (b) holds valid license from another state with substantially equivalent criteria; (c) holds valid license from state with reciprocal agreement; or (d) held valid license for at least 10 years before application. Division I contractors and roofing contractors must complete a 2-hour course on the Florida Building Code.

regulatory_model.quote: No person may engage in the business of contracting in this state without first being certified or registered in the proper classification.

credential_type.quote: The department shall issue a certificate or registration to each person qualified by the board and upon receipt of the original license fee.

is_mandatory.quote: No person may engage in the business of contracting in this state without first being certified or registered in the proper classification.

title_protection.quote: No person shall: Falsely hold himself or herself or a business organization out as a licensee, certificateholder, or registrant

scope_protection.quote: Engage in the business or act in the capacity of a contractor or advertise himself or herself or a business organization as available to engage in the business or act in the capacity of a contractor without being duly registered or certified

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a certificate or registration by fraud or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining a certificate or registration by fraud or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted or found guilty of a crime that directly relates to the practice of contracting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of, or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a crime in any jurisdiction which directly relates to the practice of contracting or the ability to practice contracting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing any act which assists a person or entity in engaging in the prohibited uncertified and unregistered practice of contracting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any act which assists a person or entity in engaging in the prohibited uncertified and unregistered practice of contracting, if the certificateholder or registrant knows or has reasonable grounds to know that the person or entity was uncertified and unregistered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly combining or conspiring with an uncertified or unregistered person by allowing certificate or registration to be used
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly combining or conspiring with an uncertified or unregistered person by allowing his or her certificate or registration to be used by the uncertified or unregistered person with intent to evade the provisions of this part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in the capacity of a contractor under any certificate or registration except in the name of the certificateholder or registrant as set forth on the issued certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting in the capacity of a contractor under any certificate or registration issued hereunder except in the name of the certificateholder or registrant as set forth on the issued certificate or registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing mismanagement or misconduct in the practice of contracting that causes financial harm to a customer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing mismanagement or misconduct in the practice of contracting that causes financial harm to a customer.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being disciplined by any municipality or county for an act or violation of this part
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being disciplined by any municipality or county for an act or violation of this part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing in any material respect to comply with the provisions of this part or violating a rule or lawful order of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing in any material respect to comply with the provisions of this part or violating a rule or lawful order of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandoning a construction project in which the contractor is engaged or under contract
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandoning a construction project in which the contractor is engaged or under contract as a contractor. A project may be presumed abandoned after 90 days if the contractor terminates the project without just cause

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing a statement with respect to a project or contract falsely indicating that the work is bonded or that payment has been made
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Signing a statement with respect to a project or contract falsely indicating that the work is bonded; falsely indicating that payment has been made for all subcontracted work, labor, and materials which results in a financial loss to the owner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing fraud or deceit in the practice of contracting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing fraud or deceit in the practice of contracting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing incompetency or misconduct in the practice of contracting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing incompetency or misconduct in the practice of contracting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing gross negligence, repeated negligence, or negligence resulting in a significant danger to life or property
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing gross negligence, repeated negligence, or negligence resulting in a significant danger to life or property.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Proceeding on any job without obtaining applicable local building department permits and inspections
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Proceeding on any job without obtaining applicable local building department permits and inspections.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intimidating, threatening, coercing, or otherwise discouraging the service of a notice to owner or notice to contractor
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intimidating, threatening, coercing, or otherwise discouraging the service of a notice to owner under part I of chapter 713 or a notice to contractor under chapter 255 or part I of chapter 713.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to satisfy within a reasonable time the terms of a civil judgment obtained against the licensee relating to the practice of the licensee's profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to satisfy within a reasonable time, the terms of a civil judgment obtained against the licensee, or the business organization qualified by the licensee, relating to the practice of the licensee's profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing misapplication of construction funds in violation of s. 713.345
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing misapplication of construction funds in violation of s. 713.345.

bonding_required.quote: To require one bond for each contractor in an amount not to exceed $5,000, which bond shall be conditioned only upon compliance with the Florida Building Code

insurance_required.quote: the applicant shall submit an affidavit on a form provided by the board attesting to the fact that the applicant has obtained workers' compensation insurance as required by chapter 440, public liability insurance, and property damage insurance for the safety and welfare of the public

definition_quote.value: Contractor means the person who is qualified for, and is only responsible for, the project contracted for and means, except as exempted in this part, the person who, for compensation, undertakes to, submits a bid to, or does himself or herself or by others construct, repair, alter, remodel, add to, demolish, subtract from, or improve any building or structure, including related improvements to real estate, for others or for resale to others
definition_quote.quote: Contractor means the person who is qualified for, and is only responsible for, the project contracted for and means, except as exempted in this part, the person who, for compensation, undertakes to, submits a bid to, or does himself or herself or by others construct, repair, alter, remodel, add to, demolish, subtract from, or improve any building or structure, including related improvements to real estate, for others or for resale to others

methods_authorized.quote: Contractors are subdivided into two divisions, Division I, consisting of those contractors defined in paragraphs (a)-(c), and Division II, consisting of those contractors defined in paragraphs (d)-(q)

registration_number_required_in_ads.quote: The registration or certification number of each contractor shall appear in each offer of services, business proposal, bid, contract, or advertisement, regardless of medium, as defined by board rule, used by that contractor or business organization in the practice of contracting.

right_of_rescission_days.quote: A residential property owner may cancel a contract to replace or repair a roof without penalty or obligation within 10 days after the execution of the contract or by the official start date, whichever comes first

deposit_cap_fraction.value: more than 10 percent triggers permit and work-start requirements
deposit_cap_fraction.quote: A contractor who receives, as initial payment, money totaling more than 10 percent of the contract price for repair, restoration, improvement, or construction to residential real property must: Apply for permits necessary to do work within 30 days after the date payment is made

minimum_project_value_usd.quote: Any work or operation of a casual, minor, or inconsequential nature in which the aggregate contract price for labor, materials, and all other items is less than $2,500

fraud_offense_defined.quote: A contractor who receives, as initial payment, money totaling more than 10 percent of the contract price for repair, restoration, improvement, or construction to residential real property must: Apply for permits necessary to do work within 30 days after the date payment is made

fraud_felony_threshold_usd.quote: A felony of the third degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084, if the total money received is $1,000 or more, but less than $20,000.

state_preempts_local_registration_fees.quote: no county or municipality may require any certificateholder to obtain a local professional license or pay a local professional license fee as a condition of performing any services within the scope of the certificateholder's statewide license as established under this part

local_trade_licensing_preserved.quote: This subsection does not affect the application of any local construction licensing ordinances.

registration_renewal_interval_years.quote: Each certificateholder or registrant who desires to continue as a certificateholder or registrant shall renew the certificate or registration every 2 years.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Liability limitation clause (limiting contractor liability to cost of inspection report or contract price)
Indemnification / hold-harmless clause favoring the promisee's sole negligence
Waiver of consumer cancellation rights clause
Waiver of consumer rights (general statutory rights) clause
Blank spaces clause (material terms left blank for later completion)
Assignment of insurance proceeds clause (without owner consent / in violation of statutory requirements)
Clause authorizing unlawful entry or breach of peace for repossession
Lien disclosure notice omission (failure to include required lien disclosure)
Disclaimer or limitation of implied warranty clause
Clause entered into by unlicensed contractor (contract with unlicensed contractor)
scope__voidable_contract_clauses.quote: contracts entered into on or after October 1, 1990, by an unlicensed contractor shall be unenforceable in law or in equity by the unlicensed contractor.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Clause requiring compliance waiver from applicable building codes or zoning regulations
Distributed energy contract clause failing to meet statutory disclosure or terms requirements
